title: registering an enemy in a bestiary after they have been "checked" by a character

posts.author: jpanboi
posts.body:
hello.
i was setting up a a bestiary with AB_EnemyBook plugin and with extensive research for almost a day i couldn't find a way to
not
register an enemy untill they've been checked by a custom skill from a battler. if there's a way to do so with other plugins or within the engine any pointers would really be appreciated

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Hmmm I haven't used that plugin, but the instructions say you can set plugin parameter 'register timing' to 0 (never), so they aren't registered in battle. Then there's a plugin command (that can be used in skill common event) 'EnemyBook add X'
edit: and there also seems to be a notetag for a skill to register stuff
